feedback.problem: What is the projection of the intersection between the sphere ${x}^{2}+{y}^{2}+(z-3)^{2}=13$ and the plane $y=3$ onto the $xz$-plane.
feedback.worked_solution:
To find the intersection of the sphere and the plane $y=3$, we substitute $y=3$ into the equation of the sphere:

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{2}+(3)^{2}+(z-3)^{2} & =13 \\ {x}^{2}+9+(z-3)^{2} & =13 \\ {x}^{2}+(z-3)^{2} & =4 \\ {x}^{2}+(z-3)^{2} & ={2}^{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Projecting this onto the $xz$-plane gives us the equation of the circle of radius $2$ centered at $(0,3).$

submitted_fields.submitted_value: The circle of radius $2$ centered at $(0,3)$
